entries.title: Psalms 131:1
segments:
PSALM CXXXI. 
 
  David testifies his humility, and exhorts Israel to trust in God,   ver. 1-3.   A song of degrees of David.

entries.title: Psalms 131:2
segments: V. 2. Surely-When my mind was provoked.  Weaned-Wholly depending upon God's providence, as the poor helpless infant, relies upon its mother for support.
